final: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>') AS funding_source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>')) SELECT funding_source, project_count, CAST(project_count AS REAL) / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(project_count AS REAL) / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS divided_by_average FROM funding_counts ORDER BY funding_source
